57:

claims.text: If an exact integral presentation is \(Q\cong\operatorname{coker}(B:\mathbb Z^u\to\mathbb Z^g)\), with Smith form \(\operatorname{diag}(d_1,\ldots,d_s,0,\ldots,0)\), \(d_i>1\), then \[ Q\cong\mathbb Z^{g-s}\oplus\bigoplus_{i=1}^s\mathbb Z/d_i,\qquad \mu_{\mathbb Z}(Q)=g-s+\max_p\#\{i:p\mid d_i\}. \]
No exact integral presentation matrix for \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\), nor a proof of its exactness, is supplied here; therefore no Smith-normal-form computation is presently justified.
